budget_decision.observed_dominant_cost: exact workspace-byte snapshots and candidate AST inspection after bounded parallel reads/inspection and one-time report-redaction context
budget_decision.decision: Do not weaken fail-closed workspace binding or add an unreviewed cache merely to meet the timing target. The bounded optimization reduced large-fixture p95 to 57.926 seconds, but the target remains open; obtain an owner-approved budget exception or a separately reviewed further algorithmic optimization before stable launch.

limitations: Static-only measurements do not include target pytest collection or dependency installation.
This is one Windows reference machine; Linux hosted evidence remains open.
A zero fixture-root disk delta reflects the read-only analysis path and is not a package-install disk budget.
